question: Does fixed global residual CDF hide visible-age heterogeneity, and does pattern persist when cell composition is fixed?
age_variable: actual origin cycle, known as-of; never lifetimefraction or eventbased age
aggregation: Each band: average each cell first, then equal present cells. Report present cells/rows; exactFraction inverseCDF for cell-equal median. Separately global population cell-equal weights1/(Ncell*ncell) age-contributions recompose overall. All3band common-cell comparison fixes cell membership; prefix composition/event proximity still differs.
reference_residual: OOF uses logy-OOFmu minus original frozen OOFmedian center; calibration uses raw logy-savedmu. Both compared with same already frozen centeredCDF q10/q90 offsets. Also report raw residual means. No centering fit on cal.
interpretation: Descriptive only; global OOF tail coverage near .1 by construction; common-cell comparison does not imply causal ageeffect; survivor selection and event proximity not removed. No conditionalcoverage guarantee/innovation/methodpromotion.
limits: No groupsearch or selection of a new prediction rule from these diagnostics
